Relief shown by hachures. Shows terrain and road conditions from Lisbon to Badajoz during the Peninsular War, 1807-1814. LC copy has ms. topography, hydrography, and road conditions by Major George Hartmann. LC copy imperfect: Stained and torn at fold lines to form three separate sections.
